```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", dpi = 300)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

source(here::here("scripts/R/functions/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02", "03", "06", "07"),
  funs = c("model_fun", "calculate_outcomes", "report_format"),
  packages = c("here", "dplyr", "knitr", "kableExtra", "scales", "dampack",
               "flexsurv", "survival"),
  set_knitr = FALSE,
  set_theme = FALSE
)
```

```{r run-scenarios, include=FALSE}
base_params <- l_params_base
scenario_defs <- list(
  list(name = "Base case", params = base_params, wtp = WTP),
  list(name = "Biosimilar pricing",
       params = within(base_params, { c_drug_nivo <- 4641 }), wtp = WTP),
  list(name = "WTP EUR 100,000", params = base_params, wtp = 100000),
  list(name = "Discount rate 0%",
       params = within(base_params, { dr_costs <- 0; dr_effects <- 0 }), wtp = WTP),
  list(name = "Discount rate 8%",
       params = within(base_params, { dr_costs <- 0.08; dr_effects <- 0.08 }), wtp = WTP),
  list(name = "Literature utilities",
       params = within(base_params, { u_np <- 0.80; u_p <- 0.65 }), wtp = WTP)
)

scenario_results <- data.frame()
for (scenario in scenario_defs) {
  result <- model_fun(scenario$params)
  result <- result[result$Strategy %in% names(strategy_labels), ]
  nmb <- result$Effect * scenario$wtp - result$Cost

  scenario_results <- rbind(scenario_results, data.frame(
    Scenario = scenario$name,
    WTP = scenario$wtp,
    Strategy = strategy_labels[result$Strategy],
    Cost = result$Cost,
    QALYs = result$Effect,
    NMB = nmb,
    Optimal = ifelse(seq_along(nmb) == which.max(nmb), "Yes", ""),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
}
```

```{r display-table}
display_df <- scenario_results %>%
  mutate(
    WTP = scales::dollar(WTP, prefix = "EUR ", accuracy = 1),
    Cost = scales::dollar(Cost, prefix = "EUR ", accuracy = 1),
    QALYs = sprintf("%.2f", QALYs),
    NMB = scales::dollar(NMB, prefix = "EUR ", accuracy = 1)
  )

kable(
  display_df,
  caption = "Table S8: Scenario analyses under alternative assumptions",
  format = "html",
  align = c("l", "r", "l", "r", "r", "r", "c")
) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, font_size = 11) %>%
  pack_rows(index = table(factor(display_df$Scenario, levels = unique(display_df$Scenario)))) %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      paste0("Base case WTP: EUR ", format(WTP, big.mark = ","), "/QALY."),
      "Biosimilar pricing sets nivolumab to EUR 4,641 per administration.",
      "Optimal strategy is the highest-NMB strategy within each scenario."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
tables_dir <- here("tables")
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
write.csv(scenario_results, file = here("tables", "table_s8.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

Table S8 has been saved to `tables/table_s8.csv`.
